purpose: Replay builder proposals from stress tests #49-#56 and distinguish repeated UI gesture from a reusable subject-neutral learner-action contract.

worth_gate.independent_recurrence: The same learner-owned action must recur in at least two independently executed frozen runs.
worth_gate.semantic_convergence: The proposals must agree on what learner state is authored/captured, not merely on a visual control such as a slider.
worth_gate.subject_neutrality: The primitive must be specifiable without polynomial/rational-function/domain-specific semantics.
worth_gate.learner_ownership: The primitive must capture or expose a learner action/observation rather than only animate authored presentation.
worth_gate.existing_composition_gap: Existing staged visuals, attempt controls, prediction/compare repair, representations and interactive_idea design records must be insufficient for the recurring need.
worth_gate.protection_and_fallback: A reusable contract must admit protected-state, accessibility, print/no-JS and restoration rules without topic-specific exceptions.
worth_gate.evidence_breadth: Recurrence confined to one benchmark/topic family is insufficient for permanent shared runtime/schema cost unless the same semantic contract is independently demonstrated across distinct task families.

proposals.learner_action: vary a bounded authored parameter, make a prediction/reason, compare derived readouts
enter/edit a value table and learner-owned plotted points
fill missing polynomial coefficient/power slots and verify alignment
move an x probe and observe original/simplified function evaluation at an excluded point
vary an authored parameter continuously and observe representation state/critical ticks

notes: #49 needs bounded parameter + prediction/reason + derived readouts.
#54 probes an independent variable at a domain exclusion and compares two function evaluations; its proposed contract embeds rational-function/domain semantics.
#56 varies a model parameter continuously to animate representation state and marked bifurcation ticks.
The commonality is a numeric range control, not a shared learner-state or evaluation contract.
All three arise inside the same polynomial stress-test family; cross-subject reuse is asserted, not independently demonstrated.
#49 itself reports the existing typed prediction/compare repair is already sufficient for the frozen learner product.

next_evidence_needed: At least one distinct task family or subject independently requiring the same semantic numeric-probe contract.
A concrete case where existing staged visual + attempt/prediction/compare composition cannot honestly represent the learner action.
Convergent authored state fields across those independent cases, not only convergent slider/range UI.
